entities.summary: Yefremov is a town and the administrative center of Yefremovsky District in Tula Oblast, Russia, located on the Krasivaya Mecha River, 149 kilometers (93 mi) south of Tula, the administrative center of the oblast. Population: 42,350 (2010 census); 47,256 (2002 census); 56,740 (1989 Soviet census).
